summary: Acceptance starting point: unbounded greedy admission previously failed in the 20-order probe. Ask the model to repair actual failure, not a seeded timetable.

candidates.name: calendar-greedy-start
candidates.hypothesis: Run the measured failing greedy policy to collect actual furnace/vehicle/window feedback for algorithm repair.
candidates.algorithm_source:
def construct():
 state=root()
 while remaining()>0:
  if complete(state): return state
  opts=candidates(state)
  if not opts: return None
  ranked=sorted([(c['start']+(c['min_hold']*.15 if c['kind']=='admit' else c['slack']*.15),c['id']) for c in opts])
  state=advance(state,ranked[0][1])
 return None
